wayuuglish-meta-title: Wayuuglish - Coming Soon | English for Indigenous Communities
wayuuglish-meta-desc: Wayuuglish is the first interactive English learning platform designed for indigenous communities.
wayuuglish-hero-subtitle: Wayuuglish bridges Wayuunaiki, Spanish, and English in an interactive, fun, and accessible learning experience tailored for indigenous communities.
wayuuglish-app-banner-desc: Take interactive English lessons everywhere. 100% offline support built specifically for rural areas and rancherias.
wayuuglish-why-subtitle: A gamified learning experience designed from ancestral culture to empower youth and communities with global opportunities.
wayuuglish-feature1-desc: Interactive lessons translated directly from Wayuunaiki into English, reinforced with native audio pronunciation recordings.
wayuuglish-feature2-desc: Runs smoothly without an active internet connection. Designed specifically for rural areas and rancherias across La Guajira.
wayuuglish-feature3-desc: Learn through play with Wayuu cultural symbols (Kanaas), traditional storytelling, achievements, and consecutive daily streak counters.
wayuuglish-feature4-desc: Didactic modules and printable guides crafted for rural schoolteachers, community elders, and autonomous study groups.
wayuuglish-demo-subtitle: Experience how Wayuuglish interactive micro-lessons work.
wayuuglish-demo-question: How do you say "Anaayawatchi" in English?
wayuuglish-demo-success: Excellent! "Thank you" is the correct translation for Anaayawatchi.
wayuuglish-demo-error: Try again! Check the available options.
wayuuglish-team-subtitle: The creators and educators committed to open-source language inclusion for indigenous communities.
wayuuglish-team-bio-dev: Developing the free and open-source web platform, offline-first interactive engine, and accessible multilingual tools.
wayuuglish-team-bio-pm: English teaching specialist guiding the pedagogical curriculum, ethno-educational methodology, and project management.
wayuuglish-faq-subtitle: Everything you need to know about the launch of Wayuuglish.
wayuuglish-faq-a1: We are currently developing the first interactive beta version. Public release of the first learning module and Android app on Google Play is scheduled for late 2026.
wayuuglish-faq-q2: Will the program and app be free?
wayuuglish-faq-a2: Yes! Wayuuglish is created with the mission to be 100% free and inclusive for indigenous students and communities.
wayuuglish-faq-q3: Which other indigenous languages will be included?
wayuuglish-faq-a3: We are starting with the Wayuu people (Wayuunaiki). Subsequently, we will expand our learning engine to other native languages.
wayuuglish-footer-mission: Empowering indigenous youth with English language skills while preserving and celebrating ancestral heritage.
wayuuglish-footer-made-with: Designed with love for indigenous communities worldwide.
